seo.title: Our services
seo.description: Market Entry Support, Partner Sourcing & Management and Local Operations Management – from market entry to day-to-day operations.

intro.title: From market entry to day-to-day operations management
intro.p1: We help companies grow their business in European markets without having to build their own local operational structure.
intro.p2: Based on each client’s individual needs, we design a suitable solution, find specialised business partners and take over the coordination of the related processes. We handle communication, performance monitoring and regular reporting so that our clients can focus on their core business goals.

overview.title: How Silverdahl supports your growth in new markets
overview.text: From market entry and partner selection to long-term operations management.

needs.title: Cooperation tailored to your needs
needs.p1: Every business project is different. That is why we do not only offer predefined service packages.
needs.p2: We can help you with a one-off supplier selection, handle the complete preparation of your entry into a new market, or take over the long-term management and coordination of your local business processes.
needs.statement: You set the business goals. We help you build and run the operational background needed to achieve them.

marketEntry.subtitle: Support for entering new markets
marketEntry.summary: We help you prepare and carry out your entry into the Czech and other European markets, and design an efficient operating model without the need to build your own local team.
intro: Entering a new market brings a number of organisational, administrative and commercial challenges. Getting to know the local environment, finding suitable suppliers and setting up operational processes correctly can take considerable time and staff capacity.

Silverdahl helps international companies prepare and carry out their entry into the Czech and other European markets. Our goal is to design an efficient way of operating locally without the need to build your own operations team.

benefit: A local partner who knows the business environment and helps you set up the necessary processes faster, reduce the organisational burden of expansion and limit the need to build your own administrative and operational capacity.
marketEntry.benefitShort: Faster market entry, less organisational effort and less need to build your own local team.

partnerSourcing.subtitle: Finding and securing specialised business partners
partnerSourcing.summary: We find, vet and secure reliable service providers, compare offers, help negotiate the best terms and organise the start of the cooperation.
intro: Reliable business partners are the foundation of every successful project. However, finding them, comparing offers and agreeing on terms can be time-consuming for a foreign company, especially one unfamiliar with the local environment.
Based on the client’s specific requirements, Silverdahl identifies and approaches suitable service providers, organises tenders and coordinates the start of the cooperation.
We are not limited to areas in which we already have experience. Depending on the nature of the project, we can map the market and find suitable specialised providers in other fields as well.

seo.title: Case study: Courlux International SA
seo.description: More than 30 years of comprehensive operational support in four European markets – the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland and Hungary.

intro.subtitle: More than 30 years of comprehensive operational support in four European markets
intro.text: The Swiss trading company Courlux International SA relies on Silverdahl as its long-term partner for business and operational activities in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland and Hungary.

task.heading: Our task
task.statement: Our task is to find suitable local suppliers, set up the cooperation and then manage the entrusted processes so that their day-to-day coordination does not burden the Swiss headquarters.

story.title: From the first business partners to comprehensive operations management
story.p1: The cooperation began with customer service, the localisation of marketing materials and the search for partners to acquire new customers. Initially these were mainly newspaper and magazine publishers through which Courlux ran its marketing campaigns.
story.p2: As the market evolved, we gradually found and contracted external call centres. For each country we organised the supplier selection, compared offers, negotiated commercial terms and then took over the coordination of their work and the evaluation of results.
story.highlightLabel: Period of the largest scope of cooperation
story.highlight: During the most intensive campaigns we coordinated up to four call centres in a single market, with total customer acquisition exceeding 30,000 new customers per month.
story.p3: Over time, we secured other specialised partners in a similar way – for example for IT support, customs declarations, postal and logistics services and legal advice.

today.title: How the cooperation works today
today.p1: Today Silverdahl independently coordinates most of Courlux’s local business and operational processes in all four markets.
today.p2: We manage the cooperation with external suppliers, continuously monitor their quality and costs, resolve operational issues and respond to changes in business requirements and legislation. One example is the successful implementation of GDPR-related processes.
today.p3: Our responsibilities also include preparing business budgets and evaluating them regularly. We provide the Swiss headquarters with daily, weekly and monthly reporting, including a comparison of actual results against the plan.
today.p4: Within approved budgets and delegated powers, we handle operational matters independently. The headquarters retains strategic and financial decisions, inventory management and the distribution of goods from Switzerland.

benefit.title: What does Courlux gain from the cooperation?
benefit.p1: For its four European markets, Courlux has one accountable operations partner who runs a network of specialised suppliers and coordinates their services day to day.
benefit.p2: Thanks to this model, Courlux does not need to build large local teams of its own or manage individual providers directly from Switzerland – while keeping continuous control over costs, quality and business results through regular reporting.
benefit.statement: Our cooperation with Courlux demonstrates our ability not only to find and secure suitable business partners, but also to take over the long-term management of entrusted processes and adapt them to the client’s changing needs.

experience.title: Experience in international business
experience.p1: Our experience comes above all from more than thirty years of cooperation with the Swiss company {company}, for which we provide comprehensive operational support in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland and Hungary.
experience.p2: Over this time we have gained extensive experience in finding business partners, negotiating terms of cooperation, managing projects, controlling costs and reporting results to headquarters abroad.

approach.title: How we work
approach.p1: We believe that successful international cooperation is built on reliable business partners, good communication and clearly defined responsibilities.
approach.p2: By taking over the coordination of entrusted processes, we ensure they run smoothly day to day, monitor the results and give the client a regular overview of the activities carried out.
approach.statement: Our greatest strength is combining knowledge of the local environment with long-standing experience of what international companies require.

kouril.focus: Strategy, business development, international partnerships and company management.
bio: Tomáš has led Silverdahl since it was founded in 1994 and shapes its strategic direction, the development of business relationships and the management of long-term cooperation with international partners.
His role focuses mainly on business negotiations, developing the partner network, setting the terms of cooperation and overseeing the company’s financial, personnel and operational performance.
Drawing on his experience of the international business environment and service outsourcing, he helps build long-term, stable business relationships.

tauchman.focus: Project management, supplier coordination, operational reporting and process optimisation.
bio: Michal has many years of experience in project management, coordinating business partners and providing operational support for international business activities.

He has worked at Silverdahl since 2008. During his career he has been involved in managing business and marketing projects, coordinating external suppliers and running operational processes for international business partners.

He specialises in organising and managing projects, coordinating cooperation between headquarters abroad and local suppliers, and operational controlling. His focus is on preparing and managing budgets, regular reporting, evaluating business results and monitoring the cost-effectiveness of individual activities.

He holds a bachelor’s degree in Marketing Communication and a master’s degree in Economics and Management, which he completed with honours. In his work he combines economic and management expertise with marketing know-how.

page.title: Cookie policy
page.intro: On this page you will find out which cookies the website uses, what they are for and how you can change your consent.
page.whatText: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. They make it possible, for example, to remember your settings or to find out how visitors use the website.
page.usedText: The website itself only uses one necessary cookie that remembers your choice. On the Contact page you can display a Google map with your consent – only then does Google store its cookies. We do not currently use any analytics or marketing tools; if we add them in the future, we will list them in this table and they will only run with your consent.
page.changeTitle: How to change or withdraw your consent
page.changeText: You can change your choice or withdraw your consent at any time – just as easily as you gave it. Simply open the cookie settings (the link is also in the footer of every page).
page.browserText: You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking necessary cookies may limit how the website works – the consent banner will then appear on every visit.
